messages.author: c437e8fd9359a95f
messages.subject: Re: DDM model
parts: Hi Nora, parameters in DDM might verify in these two experimental conditions, the way to arbitrate which parameter is changed is to compare different models' model fitting( eg., compare the model with two drift rates or model with only one drift rate). To do this, you have to modify the stan file code in hbayesdm. Also there is a package called HDDM which is specialized in DDM. You can try this one.

Hi Nora, 

Many apologies for the long delay!

1. I am not very sure the content of "choice" column. In my experiment subjects need to choose one shape from two and I counterbanlanced the positions of shape. If I label "choice" shape1=1, shape2=2, it is correct?

--> Yes

2. There are two conditions in my experiment, need I run this model separately or just together?
Looking forward your reply. 

--> We might need some more information about the task to give you a right answer. If you have two conditions (counterbalancing different shapes representing each option), then I guess you can combine the data from the two conditions if the counterbalancing makes no difference with respect to their behavioral patterns? And then apply a model to all the data? 

However, if you are comparing a multiple groups of participants (e.g., a between-subject design), then you might want to separately fit the model with each group. 

Best,
Young
